question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An afternoon performance in a theatre or cinema
solution:
The correct answer is- **'Matinee'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options,** 'Matinee'** can be used as one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• We use the word '**Matinee**' to refer - '***a performance or a show that takes place in the afternoon***'.
 
 
• **Example-** His ***matinee***__ presentation was open to the entire school.
 
 
 
• Thus, **Option 4)** is the correct answer.
